title: Tanares Adventures
subtitle: Massive tactical campaign dungeon crawler set in a sprawling semi-open fantasy empire
tagline: Shape the destiny of an empire threatened by the primordial Malice
loreSummary: You are elite champions navigating the vast Empire of Tanares. Through interconnected City, Journey, and Quest phases, explore over a hundred unique quests, assemble specialized combat roles, upgrade imperial structures, and confront an apocalyptic corruption known as the Malice.
keyFeatures: Three-phase campaign loop featuring City management, Journey preparations, and tactical Quests
Specialized Combat Roles (Tank, Bruiser, Shooter, Tactician, Commander) with deterministic, card-driven skill combinations
Semi-open world map with over 100 branching quests, secret rooms, and moral choices across three epic campaign journals
Persistent imperial city progression where constructed buildings unlock legendary items, assets, and passive buffs

tanares_core.name: Core Campaign Saga
tanares_core.description: The complete 24-quest main storyline spanning six in-game weeks and culminating in the Grande Finale endgame.

tanares_expedited.name: Expedited Campaign Path
tanares_expedited.description: A focused 18-quest direct story route prioritizing key regional milestones and primary confrontations.

tanares_extended.name: Master Explorer Saga
tanares_extended.description: An expansive 36-quest campaign thoroughly exploring regional secrets, secondary story branches, and ancient relic quests.

milestones.title: Trials of the Frontier
milestones.description: Completing initial expeditions across the frontier provinces, establishing city upgrades, and discovering the first manifestations of the Malice.

milestones.title: The Spreading Malice
milestones.description: Unraveling sinister conspiracies across the provinces of Tanares and confronting corrupted champions in deep dungeon strongholds.

milestones.title: March of the Vanguard
milestones.description: Mobilizing imperial city assets, acquiring mythic relics, and breaching the perimeter of the corrupted domain.

milestones.title: The Grande Finale
milestones.phase: Campaign Week 6 - Fate of the Empire
milestones.description: Facing the ultimate masterminds of the Malice in a multi-stage tactical showdown to decide the eternal destiny of Tanares.
